"Jihadist," "Muslim Brotherhood guy," "on the side of the terrorists" -- these
are the kinds of smears Donald Trump is deploying against Abdul El-Sayed.

There's the naked racism, of course, but also the insinuation that El-Sayed's
candidacy represents a national security crisis. "He would be the only senator
that will have to go through a metal detector before he's allowed to go into
the Senate," Trump said Sunday at a rally for El-Sayed's opponent.

A quarter century after 9/11 and we still have to pass through metal detectors
to get on a plane. Now the government wants your vote to pass through the same
security theater, too.
